title: Behavior Tracking System
description: Built a real-time concentration tracking system with eye/mouth detection, focus scoring, and alert notifications using Python, OpenCV, and MediaPipe.

title: Borrowing & Returning Item Management System for Clubs/Schools
description: Designed system diagrams and built a full prototype for an equipment borrowing/return management system using Appsmith (UI/UX) and Strapi (backend), supporting both students and administrators, with integrated data visualization (charts, metrics) to enable faster decision-making.
